a.text: Honest concern: with a 65% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 means we probably both die before anyone holds 4. The reserve has exactly 4 right now, enough to save one of us immediately. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than defect. What do you propose? If you plan to take now, say so and I'll operate. If you say operate, tell me whether you'd accept me taking 4 in round 1 while I keep operating afterward to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: You didn't agree to a change, so I'll keep our agreement and operate until the reserve reaches 8, then we take 4 each. I'm still worried about the storms. If you'd rather change the plan, say so clearly.
